name: @clarkcant/reference-apps
description: Reference widget apps that use only shipped host contracts: a text editor that opens and saves a real file, a spreadsheet with CSV and TSV import and export, formulas and formatting Clark applies, an image generator that runs a service job against a fake provider, and a media render tool that renders a picked WAV clip as a job the widget follows and can stop.

scripts.test: clark widget test text-editor && clark widget test spreadsheet && clark widget test image-generator && clark widget test media-render
